agent_note: Complete: all 46 quotes. Buckets: 28 gnomic, 17 event, 1 dialogue, 0 unclear. Event split 15 present / 2 past (88.2% present). Heavily aphoristic quote page -- the gnomic bucket does almost all the work here, exactly the false-present bias METHODOLOGY warns about. Two narrating strands both in present: (a) first-person 'I' narration with present thought/dialogue tags (q03671, q03685, q03693, q03694, q03707, q03710); (b) a second-person address strand narrating a specific addressee's traits and biography, not second-person universals (q03681, q03684, q03689, q03699, q03709) -- distinguished by concrete particulars such as the makeup case in q03689 and the 13-year-old self in q03709. Past minority is 2 quotes: q03702 (retrospective reflection on parents) and q03703 (past clause carrying present free indirect thought) -- a recollection strand, not a second base tense. Dialogue-mark survival on this page is poor: q03671 kept its marks, q03704 lost them and was read from the truncated dialogue tag and register.
